reviewerOrPass: Worker A, same AI, separate source-first pass
method: After freezing, reconstructed the 60+60+60 allocation again from the formal cohort rules, dated course periods and Dutch overview. Rechecked workbook offerings and substantive course content, then inspected the frozen schedule, audience references and alignments.
findings: The applicable 2026–2027 regulations and exact OCASYS scheme confirm 60 EC in each of the first two years. The first-year IMPACT slot requires one 10 EC choice. The second year requires political, cultural and social-economic seminars as part of a common degree. The official Dutch programme table describes the redesigned curriculum and gives exactly four types of third-year components: a 30 EC minor, one of four 10 EC IMPACT choices, a 10 EC Regions III Specialization and Public History course and a 10 EC thesis. This agrees with the new Regions title in the cohort 2026–2027 prerequisite rules. The older third-year components in the annual OER and OCASYS teaching tables apply to the cohort finishing in 2026–2027, which the OER expressly labels as the 2024–2025 cohort. The English overview table includes a mix of earlier and revised items; its duplicate thesis labels and Theory III were not used. The Dutch overview provides the published redesigned allocation, subject to ordinary future curriculum updates.

The formal Article 7.1(c) sequence for 2026–2027 entrants requires Historical Research before the three thematic seminars, at least one of them before the Regions Research Seminar, the complete first year before Regions: Specialization and Public History and both complete years before the thesis. OCASYS lists Political History in period 1a, Cultural History in 1b and regional research in 2b, satisfying the thematic prerequisite. The Dutch programme page reports the 45 EC binding study advice and reserves semester five for the minor. A 60 EC first year satisfies the study-advice threshold. The English and Dutch teaching routes share this thematic structure, with no academic route selected for the generic target.

The Dutch overview clearly presents four alternatives in one 10 EC third-year IMPACT slot. The 2026 entrant Regions prerequisite names the revised public-history course. The UCR Indigenous Histories row provides primary-source and oral-history inquiry and public multimedia, which support a specific partial match. The UCR course on the American Century provides historical inquiry but remains separate from the comparator thesis. All three repaired schedules pass offering and prerequisite validation.
